question: Who among the following was India’s longest-serving prime minister as of April 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawaharlal Nehru.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru** was **India’s longest-serving prime minister.**
 
• He was independent India’s first Prime Minister, he assumed office in 1947.
 
• His birth anniversary is celebrated as **'Children's Day'** in India because of his advocacy for the cause of children's education.
 
• He was popularly called **Chacha Nehru by children.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
